basic_details.job_title: ICAR IIMR Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 13 Young Professional, Senior Research Fellow and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The walk-in interviews of ICAR–Indian Institute of Millets Research (ICAR-IIMR) are on 18 November 2026 and 19 November 2026, with the interview time given as 10:30 AM. The venue is ICAR–Indian Institute of Millets Research, Hyderabad–500030, and candidates must report by 10:15 AM, with a grace period of 15 minutes. The institute will fill 13 contractual positions of Senior Research Fellow / Young Professional-II and Young Professional-I under the Global Centre of Excellence on Millets (Shree Anna), at ₹37,000 + HRA to ₹42,000 per month for SRF and YP-II, and ₹30,000 per month for YP-I.

The Annexure-I form asks for the candidate’s age in years as on the date of interview.

content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: ICAR–Indian Institute of Millets Research is at Rajendranagar, Hyderabad. The posts are under its Global Centre of Excellence on Millets (Shree Anna), and the notice is signed by the Nodal Officer of the GCoE. The engagement is on contract and initially up to 31 March 2027, with the possibility of further extension, subject to the requirement and availability of funds.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The vacancies add up to 13: 2 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 2 = 8 for SRF / YP-II and 3 + 1 + 1 = 5 for YP-I. For these four posts the notice sets three routes, each with a postgraduate degree in the subjects listed for the post. Post 4 (Agricultural Extension) has no such routes in the notice. A 4-year Bachelor’s degree and a 2-year Master’s degree: considered for SRF. A 3-year Bachelor’s degree and a 2-year Master’s degree with NET qualification or Ph.D.: considered for SRF. A 3-year Bachelor’s degree and a 2-year Master’s degree without NET qualification: considered for YP-II. The Senior Research Fellow (SRF) receives ₹37,000/- + HRA per month for the 1st and 2nd years and ₹42,000/- + HRA per month from the 3rd year onwards. Young Professional-II (YP-II) receives ₹42,000/- per month (fixed/consolidated). Young Professional-I (YP-I) receives ₹30,000/- per month (fixed/consolidated). Senior Research Fellow: maximum age is 35 years, with a relaxation of five years for SC/ST and women and three years for OBC. Young Professionals: minimum age is 21 years and maximum age is 45 years, with relaxation as per GOI rules. The notice does not print a separate cut-off date for age. The Annexure-I form asks for the candidate’s age in years as on the date of interview. content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Duly filled biodata in the application format Annexure-I and Annexure-II, with a photograph affixed on it and signed. The notice says a duly filled application form is compulsory. Self-attested scanned copies (PDF/JPEG) of the relevant documents, as printed in the notice. Original testimonials (date of birth, degree certificate, experience certificate, etc., if any), to be shown, plus a set of attested copies of all certificates for verification at registration and again before joining, if selected. Complete bio data and duly self-attested certificates and mark sheets from class 10th onwards, and experience certificates. A no objection certificate from the current employer, for candidates who are employed. Documentary proof of prior experience, which the Annexure-I form says is mandatory. Annexure-I asks for name in block letters, parent or spouse name, date of birth and age, present and permanent postal address, mobile number, Aadhar number, email, educational qualifications (Matriculation/SSC to Doctorate/Ph.D.), prior experience, additional information, and whether the candidate belongs to SC/ST/OBC/OC/PH/Ex-servicemen. It also asks whether the candidate is willing to be considered for a lower post if the application for the applied post is ineligible or not shortlisted for further scrutiny (Yes/No), and ends with a self declaration. Annexure-II is a declaration that no near or distant relative is an employee of ICAR-IIMR, or, alternatively, a statement of the name, designation and relationship of relatives working in ICAR.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Report at the venue by 10:15 AM; the 15-minute grace period is the only extra time allowed. Submit the filled Annexure-I and Annexure-II and show the originals at registration, along with a set of attested copies. Only candidates having the essential qualifications will be allowed to attend the interview, which starts at 10:30 AM. The notice does not describe marks, shortlisting or the way the interview decides the selection. It says the decision of the Director, ICAR-IIMR is final and binding in all respects.

faq.question: Q1. What are the walk-in interview dates for ICAR-IIMR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews are on 18 November 2026 for posts 1 to 4 (Molecular breeding/Genomics, Biochemistry, Plant Biotechnology/Molecular biology and Agricultural Extension) and on 19 November 2026 for Administration/Project Management and all Young Professional-I posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time?
faq.answer: The interview time is 10:30 AM, and candidates must report till 10:15 AM with a grace period of 15 minutes. Applications of candidates reporting after the prescribed time will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q3. Where is the walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: It is held at ICAR–Indian Institute of Millets Research, Hyderabad–500030.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 13 positions: 8 for Senior Research Fellow / Young Professional-II and 5 for Young Professional-I.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for Young Professional-I?
faq.answer: For Molecular Breeding/Green House it is a minimum 3-year undergraduate degree in agriculture or Horticulture. For Bio-Chemistry it is a Master’s degree in Biochemistry/Analytical Chemistry/Food Technology/Food Science and Nutrition. For Seed Science & Technology it is MSc. (Agriculture) with specialization in Seed Science and Technology/Crop Physiology/Genetics and Plant Breeding.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years for Senior Research Fellow, with five years relaxation for SC/ST and women and three years for OBC. For Young Professionals it is a minimum of 21 years and a maximum of 45 years, with relaxation as per GOI rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary?
faq.answer: SRF gets ₹37,000/- + HRA per month in the 1st and 2nd years and ₹42,000/- + HRA per month from the 3rd year. YP-II gets ₹42,000/- per month and YP-I gets ₹30,000/- per month, both fixed/consolidated.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents should I bring?
faq.answer: Bring the duly filled Annexure-I and Annexure-II with a photograph affixed and signed, originals and a set of attested copies of certificates, self-attested mark sheets from class 10th onwards, experience certificates and, if employed, a no objection certificate from the current employer.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the posts are purely temporary and on contractual basis till the expiry of the project, initially up to 31 March 2027, with possible extension subject to requirement and availability of funds. Selected candidates cannot claim regular appointment or absorption.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel allowance be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, the notice says no TA/DA or any other expenses will be paid for attending the interview.
